articles.title: How to measure for curtains
articles.summary: Track, drop, allowances — in five minutes
articles.content:
## Track length

Measure the track from end to end — not the window. Curtains should cover the window with 15–20 cm to spare on each side.

## Drop

From the track hook (or the top of the pole) to the length you want: to the sill minus 1 cm, to the floor minus 1–2 cm, puddled on the floor plus 3–5 cm.

## Eyelets

For eyelet curtains add 3 cm at the top.

Photograph the whole window and send it to a consultant — we will check your figures free of charge.

articles.title: Making and delivery times
articles.summary: 5–7 working days to make, 3–5 to deliver nationwide
articles.content:
Making takes **5–7 working days** once the quote is agreed and paid.

### Within London

Courier — £15, free on orders over £400. Slots 10:00–13:00, 13:00–17:00, 17:00–20:00. The courier calls an hour ahead.

### Across the country

DPD to a pickup point or to your door, 3–5 working days. The tracking number arrives by e-mail on the day of dispatch.

secondRevision.summary: 5–7 working days to make, 3–5 to deliver nationwide. Moving your slot is free
secondRevision.contentAppend:
### Moving your delivery

You can move the slot free of charge until 18:00 the day before — write to us in the chat or at info@nord-atelier.com.

articles.title: Returns and exchanges
articles.summary: Ready-made items — 14 days; made to measure — remade if faulty
articles.content:
Ready-made items from the catalogue can be returned within **14 days** if they have not been used.

Items made to your own measurements cannot be returned (bespoke goods are exempt from the cancellation right under the Consumer Contracts Regulations), except where they are faulty or do not match the order: wrong colour or size, defects in the making. In that case we remake or exchange them free of charge, in 5–7 working days.

To make a claim, send us your order number and photographs of the item in the chat.

articles.title: Your account: signing in and resetting a password
articles.summary: The reset e-mail arrives within 5 minutes
articles.content:
You sign in with your e-mail. The password reset message comes from no-reply@nord-atelier.com within 5 minutes. If it has not arrived, check your spam folder. You can ask for another one after 10 minutes.

Order statuses: “Awaiting payment” → “In production” → “Ready” → “Handed to the courier” → “Delivered”.

articles.title: How to care for your curtains
articles.summary: Washing and ironing by fabric type
articles.content:
**Blackout** — delicate wash at 30°, no spin, iron on the reverse at the lowest setting.

**Linen** — wash at 40°; shrinkage of up to 3% is already allowed for in the measurements.

**Velvet** — dry clean only.

**Voile** — wash at 30° in a mesh bag, dry it hanging on the track.

articles.title: Paying in instalments
articles.content: For orders over £1,200 you can pay 50% when you order and 50% before dispatch. Draft — to be agreed with the finance team.
